meta.title: Gold ring dataset
rules: One entry = one product page on the seller's own domain.
A value is only stored if it is quoted from that page and the page was opened on the date in 'checked'.
check = live  → the page was fetched and read in this project.
check = snapshot → the value was seen in a search-engine copy of the seller page, NOT re-read on the page. Price is deliberately left blank.
check = dead → the page exists but the item is no longer purchasable.
price_type = setting → the price excludes the centre diamond; never compare it to a melt value.
price_type = from → the page says 'From $X'; the real price depends on size/material.

items.title: Classic Simple Solitaire Engagement Ring in 14k White Gold
items.notes: Setting only: the centre diamond is chosen separately, so the $1,145 is the metal + side-stone work. Page states the 14K white gold version has a rhodium finish (which 16 CFR 23.7 requires sellers to disclose). Gram weight is not published on the page.

items.title: Bold Diamond Eternity Ring

ev.color: 14k solid white gold pieces are finished with rhodium plating

items.notes: Explicitly says solid 14k gold (unusually clear). Price is 'From' and moves with metal colour/size: a search-engine copy of the same Mejuri collection page showed $3,400 for one variant, so only the $2,900 floor is recorded. Returns: free 30 days, but engraved pieces are excluded.

items.title: Italian 14kt Yellow Gold Diamond-Cut Ring

observations.via: search-engine copy of the same page (stale)

items.notes: Useful as a weight benchmark because Ross-Simons publishes the gram weight. The page qualifies it: "All weights and measurements are approximate." It does NOT say solid gold anywhere on the page. The search-engine copy of this same URL showed $270 while the live page showed $299 — recorded as a price-drift finding rather than quietly picking one.
